title: Vande Bharat Trials Begin
summary: The South Western Railway has begun safety trials of the Vande Bharat Express train on the Sakleshpur ghat section of the Mangaluru-Bengaluru route. The trials are significant as this section is one of the most technically demanding stretches on the railway line. Successful trials would pave the way for introducing the Vande Bharat Express on the Bengaluru-Mangaluru sector. The field trials consider the ghat section between Sakleshpur and Subrahmanya Road. The trials are a crucial step in ensuring the safety and feasibility of the Vande Bharat Express on this route.
